General London Europe U.S. Bangalore Program What is Talent Investing? At Entrepreneurs First, we believe today’s founders have the opportunity to shape mankind’s future in profound ways. It not only matters what companies get started. But it matters who starts them. We believe that for many of these talented future founders, entrepreneurship is not an obvious or entirely legible career path. We therefore exist to identify and invest in these exceptional individuals. Individuals with enormous potential, insatiable curiosity, and an impatience for impact. We back these individuals to become the founders of tomorrow’s exceptional businesses. We call this Talent Investing; every founder on our programs will work with a Talent Investor to maximize their chances of success during the program. What does EF offer? Cofounder matching A tried and tested, systematic cofounder matching process to help you find a compatible CEO/CTO. Exposure to a peer-group of exceptional, like-minded talent. Investing in Talent | Entrepreneurs First [START] Apply Insights FAQs [MENU] About us Portfolio Careers Entrepreneurs First [START] Apply Insights FAQs [MENU] About us Portfolio Careers About Us Founded by Alice Bentinck and Matt Clifford, Entrepreneurs First is a category-defining global investor in entrepreneurial talent. Our portfolio companies are backed by world-leading investors, including Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Softbank, and Khosla Ventures. Together they are worth over $24B and include a number of unicorns and successful exits. We have offices in London, Paris, Bangalore, and San Francisco; enabling EF to be the bridge to Silicon Valley that connects global talent to the richest startup ecosystem. Pioneers of global talent investing We started Entrepreneurs First over a decade ago, after seeing many talented future founders become lost to the status quo. Outside of Silicon Valley, entrepreneurship is rarely seen as a viable route for ambitious individuals. Instead the ambitions of the talented are constrained by the current social currencies of success; high status jobs, citation counts, promotion cycles. Our goal at EF is to liberate you from these artificial limits. To reframe what’s possible and help you shape the world in more profound ways. We do this by building cohorts of exceptional peers, curated from leading academic institutions and tech communities
